Which customer has the highest total spend across their completed orders?

finalSql:
SELECT c.name AS customer_name, SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS total_spend
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT products.category, SUM(order_items.unit_price * order_items.quantity) AS total_revenue
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id

GROUP BY products.category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

What is the average total spend per customer, counting only completed orders?

finalSql:
SELECT AVG(total_spend) AS average_total_spend
FROM (
    SELECT
        customers.customer_id,
        SUM(order_items.unit_price * order_items.quantity) AS total_spend
    FROM customers
    JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
    JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
    WHERE orders.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY customers.customer_id
) AS per_customer_spend
